arabic text:
AY MERE BABAJAAN, HORAHI HAI AZAAN,
SAR CHHUPAUN KAHA
AGAYA KARVAAN
MAJMAYE AAM ME, BE WATAN BE AMAAN
english translation text:
O MY FATHER, THE AZAAN IS BEING RECITED
HOW SHALL I HIDE MY HEAD?
IN THIS HUGE CROWD, AWAY FROM HOME AND NO PROTECTION
THE CARAVAN HAS COME

arabic text:
ME BHI HUN MARZIYA, BINTE KHAYRUN NISA
MERE LEHJE ME HAI, BABA TERI ADA
NAAM ZAINAB MERA, TUNE JO RAKHDIYA
DAY DI APNI ZUBAAN
english translation text:
I AM MARZIYA, DAUGHTER OF FATIMA
IN MY ACTIONS, I AM LIKE YOU MY FATHER
MY NAME IS ZAINAB, YOU GAVE ME THAT NAME
AND YOU GAVE ME MY WORDS

arabic text:
BABAJAAN ME RIDA MANGTI REHGAYI,
BAAMO DAR SAJ GAYE, JITEJI MARGAYI,
HALQAYE SHAAM ME, NAM SUNKAR MERA
MARGAYA NAATAWAN
english translation text:
FATHER I KEPT ASKING FOR HIJAB
I WAS BROKEN, SEEING ALL THE DECORATED BUILDINGS
IN SHAAM, HEARING MY NAME TAKEN
IMAM SAJJAD WAS GRIEF STRICKEN

arabic text:
HAATH KANO PE HAI, NEEL GAALON PE HAI,
AUR NISHAN JO SAKINA KE SHAANO PE HAI
HAR NISHAN SE YAHI, AA RAHI HAI SADA
BABAJAAN BABAJAAN
english translation text:
HER HANDS ON HER EARS, MARKS ON HER CHEEKS
AND THE MARKS THAT ARE ON SAKINA’S SHOULDERS...
EVERY WOUND OF HERS IS CRYING OUT
OH FATHER OH FATHER

arabic text:
SHAAM ASHUR SE, SHAMO KUFA TALAK,
MAINE MANGA NAHI HAI KHARAJE FADAK,
MERI CHADAR SE HAI, MERI MAA KA SUKUN
SUNLE ZALIM JAHAAN
english translation text:
FROM THE NIGHT OF ASHUR,
TO SHAM AND KUFA
I DID NOT ASK FOR MY DUES OF FIDAK
THE PEACE OF MY MOTHER’S HEART
LISTEN OH CRUEL WORLD!
IS IN MY VEIL

arabic text:
BABAJAAN YE TERA AKHRI THA BAYAN,
TERI CHADAR BACHAYEGA GHAZI JAWAAN
MARGAYA BAWAFA, CHINGAYI HAI RIDA,
KEHTI HAI BIBIYA
english translation text:
THIS WAS YOUR LAST WORD OH BELOVED FATHER...
THAT YOUR VEIL WILL BE PROTECTED BY ABBAS
THE PROTECTOR HAS BEEN KILLED, THE VEIL HAS BEEN SNATCHED,
AND THE LADIES ARE CALLING OUT...

arabic text:
RUK NA PAYA MERE BAWAFA KA WO SAR,
NOKE NEZA SE AANE LAGA KHAAK PAR,
BEHN KO DARBADAR, DEKHKAR NANGE SAR
SEH NA PAYA JAWAAN
english translation text:
ABBAS COULDN’T BEAR IT
THE HEAD OF ABBAS COULD NOT STOP
FALLING TO THE GROUND FROM THE SPEAR’S HEAD
SEEING HIS SISTER WITHOUT A VEIL EVERYWHERE

arabic text:
KAL THI MAA AAJ ME BHI HUN DARBAR ME,
MISLE ZAHRA KHARI HUN ME AGHYAR ME,
BEPADAR BETIYAN
US TARAF HAI SHAQI, IS TARAF REHGAYI
english translation text:
THE ORPHANED DAUGHTERS
YESTERDAY IT WAS MY MOTHER, TODAY I AM IN THE COURT
JUST LIKE ZAHRA, I AM STANDING NOW IN FRONT OF STRANGERS
ON ONE SIDE, THE OPPRESSOR – ON THE OTHER SIDE
